request.text: A DLL was planted in Internet Explorer's folder on WORKSTATION6 from WORKSTATION5, and an IE started over DCOM spawned a notepad that is calling out. Contain host WORKSTATION6.theshire.local.

package.rationale: From WORKSTATION5, pgustavo wrote iertutil.dll into C:\Program Files\Internet Explorer on WORKSTATION6 over the C$ share; Internet Explorer then started over DCOM (-Embedding), loaded the planted DLL and spawned notepad.exe, which connects to 10.10.10.5:80. DCOM lateral movement with a DLL hijack delivered an implant; isolate WORKSTATION6.
